decisions.decision: Scoped Step-1 evidence gathering as a focused (non-systematic) review: OpenAlex scoping searches + ASPECT source canvas + two seed papers read in full; full claim-verification gate deferred to manuscript stage.
decisions.why: Prototyping study needs strategies fast; systematic-review machinery would be disproportionate before benchmark design exists.

decisions.decision: Recommend S2 (relaxed pressure, plugin-only) first and S1b (explicit RHS bulk force) in parallel; full implicit S1 deferred to upstream ASPECT contribution (needs source access + rebuild).
decisions.why: Canvas proved no bulk-viscosity slot or LHS term exists outside melt transport; plugin-only routes work with the installed 3.2.0-pre build.

decisions.decision: Test ALL strategies S1-S4 across 1-3 box benchmarks; paper frames compromises between oscillation-free solutions, physical accuracy, and computational practicality. S1 implemented in user ASPECT fork (workspace/aspect, synced upstream main) on agent branches + PRs; benchmarks link against fork build.
decisions.why: User direction: full comparison is the paper.

decisions.decision: Step-2 increments: S1-minimal (constant zeta: BulkViscosityOutputs + StokesBulkViscosityTerm + enable flag, preconditioner/dt-limiter deferred); ONE 1-reaction box benchmark first; build fork on this Mac (-j8, /opt/dealii).
decisions.why: User answers: minimal S1 cut, 1 benchmark, local build.

decisions.decision: Refactored nh-kinetics onto ReactionChain (Cahn Interface-controlled-growth, N=1) with clean SI prefactor Z=4.44e-04 used directly (no time_scale division; cookbook division flagged for separate upstream fix). Prms renamed to descriptive undamped/implicit_bulk/explicit_bulk/relaxed_pressure/capped_pressure with stepped 3200/3850 init. Combined fork branch agent/bulk-viscosity-chain (stack + S1) gives a single build for all five.
decisions.why: Upstream review readiness; chain clamp is the maintained overshoot fix; descriptive names for the paper.

decisions.decision: With clamping active, all five refactored variants are quasi-static: xi bounded, no front dynamics; +72 MPa bottom high is a setup boundary feature (survived stepped init, not an init shock); front dynamic pressure ~5 MPa too small to drive kinetics. Old S1/S1b dipoles and S0 blowup traced to missing post-integration clamp. Next: redesign benchmark (slower through-flow/sharper gradients/slower kinetics) so damping strategies visibly separate.
decisions.why: Refactored sweep evidence: undamped/explicit/capped ~identical (+72/-5 MPa); implicit adds only a -9 MPa transient at +20% Stokes cost; relaxed keeps -317 MPa corner low.

methodology: Focused literature scoping + code canvas to formulate implementable benchmark strategies
next_action: PAUSED: design higher-gradient 1-reaction benchmark (flow/kinetics competition) before zeta/tau/cap sweeps; S1 build validated on agent/bulk-viscosity-chain
question: How can dynamic (non-hydrostatic) pressure govern phase transformations in compressible mantle-convection models without generating spurious pressure oscillations, and what role can a bulk-viscosity term (viscous-relaxation timescale) play, compatibly with ASPECT's projected density approximation (PDA)?
